library.name: oMLX
library.description: Integration with oMLX for local models on Apple silicon
library.instructions:
# Instructions

* Start oMLX on your Mac and note the port it serves on (`8000` by default)
* If your server was started with an API key, enter it below. **A local server usually has none -- leave the key blank in that case**
* When you add an agent model, choose the **oMLX** provider and set the endpoint to your server:
  * Cerb in Docker: `http://host.docker.internal:8000`
  * Cerb on the same Mac: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`
* Leave **Authentication** empty on the agent model if your server has no key. Only choose this account when you entered one above
* **Refresh** beside Model lists what you have actually converted, which is the only reliable source for a local server

params.placeholder: (leave blank if your server has no key)
